game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling heat shields into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Sort falling heat shields into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the fire shrine using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the fire shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The fire shrine reached with actions_used <= 18.
